title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
title_zh: SwarmEvolve：面向进化发现与优化的潜在空间智能体集群

paragraphs.en: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve , a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents’ hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score and needs a median of only 3 to 8 minutes to reach the best scores that other state-of-the-art frameworks reach in 60 minutes. On several problems, SwarmEvolve with Qwen3 8B improves on the solutions that AlphaEvolve first found with frontier LLMs. Our work shows that agent swarms that communicate in latent space offer a fast, low-cost approach to program search for scientific problems.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 引导的进化搜索利用智能体来改进数学与计算问题的程序，其方式是迭代地精炼解法并组合高分方法。 然而，这一过程通常很慢，因为 LLM 每一轮都要生成冗长的文本思维链，并且为了保持种群多样性必须多次重复这一生成过程。 我们提出 SwarmEvolve，这是一个框架，其中每轮有数百个低成本智能体以群体形式工作，在潜空间中进行推理而无需解码为文本，并通过传递 KV 缓存来共享信息。 每个群体从不同角度研究该问题。 新颖性过滤器通过直接测量智能体隐状态向量之间的距离，保留最独特的智能体想法。 想法的交叉在潜空间中自然发生，因为一个总结智能体会接收所有群体成员合并后的 KV 缓存。 在数学发现与科学计算的 21 个问题上，SwarmEvolve 取得了最高的平均分，并且达到其他最先进框架在 60 分钟内所得最优分数所需的中位数时间仅为 3 到 8 分钟。 在若干问题上，使用 Qwen3 8B 的 SwarmEvolve 改进了 AlphaEvolve 最初使用前沿 LLM 找到的解法。 我们的工作表明，在潜空间中通信的智能体群体为科学问题的程序搜索提供了一种快速、低成本的方法。

paragraphs.en: Many problems in mathematics and scientific computing can be framed as a search for a good program. Examples include symbolic regression, optimizing constants in inequalities, and building robust solvers for differential equations. This search can be carried out through evolutionary computation, a method to iteratively improve candidate programs through variation, crossover, and selection [ 32 , 39 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 数学与科学计算中的许多问题都可以被表述为对一个优质程序的搜索。 例子包括符号回归、优化不等式中的常数，以及构建鲁棒的微分方程求解器。 这种搜索可以通过演化计算来进行，这是一种通过变异、交叉和选择来迭代改进候选程序的方法 [ 32 , 39 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Recently, LLMs have been used as the mutation and crossover operators in such evolutionary processes [ 43 , 49 , 73 ] . These LLM-guided frameworks have made strong progress on many open problems. In particular, FunSearch found new cap set constructions [ 54 ] , and AlphaEvolve found a more efficient algorithm for multiplying 4 × 4 4\times 4 complex matrices [ 50 ] . Later work applied this approach to solve many more problems in mathematics and computer systems [ 24 , 20 , 12 ] . These frameworks differ mainly in how they explore. FunSearch evolves programs on separate islands, and AlphaEvolve and its open-source variants add a MAP-Elites archive to keep diverse programs [ 59 , 1 , 37 ] . To save LLM calls, some methods reject near-duplicate proposals, adaptively allocate the search budget, or evolve the search strategy itself [ 42 , 10 , 46 ] . Others guide exploration with better context, such as how past changes affected the score, related literature, simulated peer review, or a solver split into separate steps [ 34 , 45 , 78 , 40 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 最近，大语言模型已被用作此类进化过程中的变异和交叉算子 [ 43 , 49 , 73 ] 。 这些由大语言模型引导的框架在许多开放性问题上取得了显著进展。 其中，FunSearch 发现了新的 cap set 构造 [ 54 ] ，AlphaEvolve 则找到了一种更高效的 4 × 4 4\times 4 复数矩阵乘法算法 [ 50 ] 。 后续工作将这一方法应用于解决数学和计算机系统中的更多问题 [ 24 , 20 , 12 ] 。 这些框架的主要区别在于它们探索问题的方式。 FunSearch 在相互独立的岛屿上演化程序，而 AlphaEvolve 及其开源变体则增加了 MAP-Elites 存档以保持程序的多样性 [ 59 , 1 , 37 ] 。 为节省大语言模型调用次数，一些方法会拒绝近似重复的提案、自适应地分配搜索预算，或对搜索策略本身进行演化 [ 42 , 10 , 46 ] 。 另一些方法则借助更好的上下文来引导探索，例如过往修改对分数的影响、相关文献、模拟同行评审，或将求解器拆分为独立的步骤 [ 34 , 45 , 78 , 40 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Recent work also scales up the search. Some methods run many parallel trajectories [ 77 ] or train the LLM on each problem with reinforcement learning [ 79 , 64 , 70 ] . Others use more agents with different roles, such as an ensemble of frontier LLMs in AlphaEvolve, multi-agent debate, and coding agents that coordinate through shared memory or an orchestrator [ 35 , 52 , 69 ] . When agents build on one another’s findings, they have produced new results on open problems [ 9 , 7 ] . These works suggest that diverse proposals, cross-pollination of ideas, and iterative refinement are key to new discoveries on open scientific problems.

paragraphs.en: Can swarms of low-cost agents make evolutionary search faster and better?

paragraphs.en: We present SwarmEvolve , an evolutionary search framework in which swarms of low-cost latent agents reason in latent space and communicate by passing KV caches. It builds on recent work on latent reasoning, where an LLM reasons with continuous vectors instead of sampled tokens [ 29 , 80 , 60 , 74 , 82 ] , and on latent communication, where LLMs exchange token embeddings [ 51 ] , activations [ 53 ] , hidden states [ 81 , 19 , 84 ] , or KV caches [ 61 , 23 ] instead of text messages. In particular, LatentMAS combines both without training. Its agents reason in latent space and pass their KV caches to a summarizer that writes the answer [ 85 ] . We use this mechanism as the basis for large-scale, low-cost evolutionary search.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SwarmEvolve，一个演化搜索框架，其中由低成本的潜在智能体组成的群体在潜在空间中推理，并通过传递 KV 缓存进行通信。 它建立在近期关于潜在推理的工作之上，即大语言模型使用连续向量而非采样得到的词元进行推理 [29, 80, 60, 74, 82]，以及关于潜在通信的工作之上，即大语言模型之间交换词元嵌入 [51]、激活值 [53]、隐藏状态 [81, 19, 84] 或 KV 缓存 [61, 23]，而非文本消息。 特别是，LatentMAS 无需训练即可将两者结合起来。 其智能体在潜在空间中推理，并将各自的 KV 缓存传递给一个负责撰写答案的汇总器 [85]。 我们以该机制为基础进行大规模、低成本的演化搜索。

paragraphs.en: Because latent reasoning and communication are cheap, SwarmEvolve runs hundreds of agents in each round of evolution. The agents form distinct swarms, and each swarm has its own focus, such as implementing a construction from the literature or using a textbook method. Inside a swarm, each agent reasons from its unique perspective for 40 latent steps. A novelty filter then keeps the agents in each swarm whose latent reasoning trajectories are farthest apart in cosine distance. Finally, each swarm’s summarizer agent reads the KV caches of the kept agents and writes one new program.
paragraphs.zh: 由于潜在推理与通信的成本很低，SwarmEvolve 在每一轮进化中运行数百个智能体。 这些智能体形成不同的群集，每个群集都有自己的关注点，例如实现文献中的一种构造或使用教科书中的方法。 在一个群集内部，每个智能体从其独特的视角进行 40 步潜在推理。 随后，一个新颖性过滤器在每个群集中保留那些潜在推理轨迹在余弦距离上相距最远的智能体。 最后，每个群集的总结智能体读取被保留智能体的 KV 缓存，并写出一段新的程序。

paragraphs.en: Greater diversity. While existing methods generate one response at a time or run a small team of agents, SwarmEvolve runs 450 latent agents per round, each with a different specialization, parent program, and way of thinking, and so samples far more diverse proposals.
paragraphs.zh: 更高的多样性。 现有方法每次只生成一个响应，或运行一小队智能体，而 SwarmEvolve 每轮运行 450 个潜在智能体，每个智能体具有不同的专长、父程序和思维方式，因此能采样到更多样化的方案。

paragraphs.en: We compare SwarmEvolve with OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve, and CodeEvolve on 21 problems from mathematical discovery and scientific computing. Each framework runs with Qwen3 8B, 14B, and 32B-FP8 [ 75 ] for 60 minutes on one GPU ( Figure 1 ). SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score with all three models. With Qwen3 8B, it scores higher than all three baselines with Qwen3 32B-FP8. After only 15 minutes, it already scores higher than the 60-minute averages of all baselines with every model. On three problems, SwarmEvolve with a frozen Qwen3 8B also improves on the constructions that AlphaEvolve originally found with frontier Gemini models. These results suggest that swarms of low-cost latent agents are a fast and scalable way to use AI for open mathematical and scientific discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在来自数学发现与科学计算的 21 个问题上，将 SwarmEvolve 与 OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve 和 CodeEvolve 进行比较。 每个框架均在单个 GPU 上使用 Qwen3 8B、14B 和 32B-FP8 [ 75 ] 运行 60 分钟（图 1）。 SwarmEvolve 在全部三个模型上都取得了最高的平均分。 使用 Qwen3 8B 时，它的得分高于所有使用 Qwen3 32B-FP8 的三个基线。 仅运行 15 分钟后，它在每个模型上的得分就已高于所有基线 60 分钟的平均分。 在三个问题上，使用冻结的 Qwen3 8B 的 SwarmEvolve 也超越了 AlphaEvolve 最初使用前沿 Gemini 模型得到的构造。 这些结果表明，由低成本潜智能体组成的群体是一种将 AI 用于开放性数学与科学发现的快速且可扩展的方式。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we introduce the preliminary setup and notations for our method.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍我们方法的预备设置与符号。

paragraphs.en: We use decoder-only transformer LLMs [ 68 ] , which embed the input token at position t t as a vector 𝐞 t ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{e}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , where d d is the hidden dimension, and pass the sequence through L L transformer layers. The output of the last layer at position t t is the last hidden state 𝐡 t ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{h}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} . The LLM computes the distribution of the next token from 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用仅解码器的 transformer 大语言模型 [ 68 ]，其将位置 t t 的输入词元嵌入为向量 𝐞 t ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{e}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}，其中 d d 为隐藏维度，并将该序列通过 L L 层 transformer 层。 最后一层在位置 t t 的输出即为最后的隐藏状态 𝐡 t ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{h}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}。 大语言模型从 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} 计算下一个词元的分布。

sents.en: We use decoder-only transformer LLMs [ 68 ] , which embed the input token at position t t as a vector 𝐞 t ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{e}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , where d d is the hidden dimension, and pass the sequence through L L transformer layers.
sents.zh: 我们使用仅解码器的 transformer 大语言模型 [ 68 ]，其将位置 t t 的输入词元嵌入为向量 𝐞 t ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{e}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}，其中 d d 为隐藏维度，并将该序列通过 L L 层 transformer 层。

sents.en: The output of the last layer at position t t is the last hidden state 𝐡 t ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{h}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} .
sents.zh: 最后一层在位置 t t 的输出即为最后的隐藏状态 𝐡 t ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{h}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}。

sents.en: The LLM computes the distribution of the next token from 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} .
sents.zh: 大语言模型从 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} 计算下一个词元的分布。

paragraphs.en: Inside each layer, the query 𝐪 t \mathbf{q}_{t} of position t t attends to the keys 𝐤 j \mathbf{k}_{j} and values 𝐯 j \mathbf{v}_{j} of all positions j ≤ t j\leq t . Because the keys and values of a position depend only on the tokens up to that position, the LLM stores them in a KV cache { ( 𝐊 ( ℓ ) , 𝐕 ( ℓ ) ) } ℓ = 1 L \{(\mathbf{K}^{(\ell)},\mathbf{V}^{(\ell)})\}_{\ell=1}^{L} , where 𝐊 ( ℓ ) \mathbf{K}^{(\ell)} and 𝐕 ( ℓ ) \mathbf{V}^{(\ell)} stack the keys and values of all positions in layer ℓ \ell . Each new token then costs one forward pass of a single position, which attends to the KV cache and appends its own keys and values to it. The KV cache of a shared prefix, such as a problem statement, is usually computed once and reused by every sequence that continues it for efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 在每一层内部，位置 t t 的查询 𝐪 t \mathbf{q}_{t} 会关注所有位置 j ≤ t j\leq t 的键 𝐤 j \mathbf{k}_{j} 和值 𝐯 j \mathbf{v}_{j} 。 由于一个位置的键和值仅依赖于该位置之前的词元，LLM 将它们存储在 KV 缓存 { ( 𝐊 ( ℓ ) , 𝐕 ( ℓ ) ) } ℓ = 1 L \{(\mathbf{K}^{(\ell)},\mathbf{V}^{(\ell)})\}_{\ell=1}^{L} 中，其中 𝐊 ( ℓ ) \mathbf{K}^{(\ell)} 和 𝐕 ( ℓ ) \mathbf{V}^{(\ell)} 堆叠了第 ℓ \ell 层中所有位置的键和值。 这样，每个新词元只需进行单个位置的一次前向传播，该前向传播会关注 KV 缓存，并将自身的键和值追加到其中。 共享前缀（例如问题陈述）的 KV 缓存通常只计算一次，并被续接该前缀的每个序列复用，以提高效率。

paragraphs.en: LLMs usually reason by decoding a chain of thought in text [ 71 , 38 ] . In latent reasoning, the LLM instead feeds the last hidden state 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} back as the next input embedding 𝐞 t + 1 \mathbf{e}_{t+1} , so it reasons in its continuous embedding space without sampling tokens [ 29 , 80 , 83 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型通常通过在文本中解码思维链来进行推理 [ 71 , 38 ] 。 在潜在推理中，大语言模型转而将最后一个隐藏状态 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} 作为下一个输入嵌入 𝐞 t + 1 \mathbf{e}_{t+1} 反馈回来，从而在其连续嵌入空间中进行推理，而无需采样词元 [ 29 , 80 , 83 ] 。

paragraphs.en: To start a round, SwarmEvolve forms 10 swarms of 45 latent agents each. All agents in a swarm share one main focus. Each agent receives a distinct prompt, which combines one of five phrasings of this focus with one of nine ways of thinking, such as reasoning from first principles or reconsidering assumptions (Supplementary Table 4 ). paragraphs.en: We compare SwarmEvolve with three state-of-the-art frameworks: OpenEvolve [ 59 ] , ShinkaEvolve [ 42 ] , and CodeEvolve [ 1 ] on 21 problems from five domains (Appendix D ). Sixteen of these problems, in packing, geometry, analysis, and combinatorics, come from Appendix B of AlphaEvolve [ 50 ] . For these problems, we use the same problem statements, initial programs, and evaluators from OpenEvolve. The score of each problem is its objective value divided by that of the construction published by AlphaEvolve, so a score above 1 improves on AlphaEvolve.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 SwarmEvolve 与三个最先进的框架在来自五个领域的 21 个问题上进行比较：OpenEvolve [ 59 ]、ShinkaEvolve [ 42 ] 和 CodeEvolve [ 1 ]（附录 D）。 这些问题中有十六个来自 packing、geometry、analysis 和 combinatorics 领域，取自 AlphaEvolve [ 50 ] 的附录 B。 对于这些问题，我们使用与 OpenEvolve 相同的问题描述、初始程序和评估器。 每个问题的得分是其目标值除以 AlphaEvolve 公布的构造的目标值，因此得分高于 1 即表示超越了 AlphaEvolve。

paragraphs.en: SwarmEvolve evaluates 5 to 13 times more programs per hour than the baselines ( Figure 1 , left). This difference comes from how the frameworks spend GPU time. The baselines spend most of it on text reasoning, which takes 20 to 35 seconds per program. In contrast, the 450 latent agents of one round take only a few seconds in total. The novelty filter of SwarmEvolve also saves time, because it uses the hidden states of the agents directly. ShinkaEvolve instead needs an external embedding model and an LLM judge to reject similar proposals. Supplementary Table 2 gives a detailed time breakdown.
paragraphs.zh: SwarmEvolve 每小时评估的程序数量是基线方法的 5 到 13 倍（图 1，左）。 这一差异来自各框架如何分配 GPU 时间。 基线方法把大部分时间花在文本推理上，每个程序需要 20 到 35 秒。 相比之下，一轮中的 450 个潜在智能体总共只需几秒钟。 SwarmEvolve 的新颖性过滤器也能节省时间，因为它直接使用智能体的隐藏状态。 ShinkaEvolve 则需要外部嵌入模型和 LLM 裁判来拒绝相似的提案。 补充表 2 给出了详细的时间分解。

paragraphs.en: With Qwen3 8B, SwarmEvolve surpasses AlphaEvolve’s published constructions on three problems, compared with one for each baseline (Supplementary Table 5 ). Its packing of 26 circles in a square reaches the best known sum of radii, 2.635983 [ 62 ] , and its step functions improve AlphaEvolve’s bounds for the second and third autocorrelation inequalities. While AlphaEvolve relies on frontier LLMs, SwarmEvolve achieves these results with swarms of small open-weight LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Qwen3 8B，SwarmEvolve 在三个问题上超越了 AlphaEvolve 已发表的构造结果，而每个基线方法各自仅在其中一个问题上做到这一点（补充表 5）。 其在正方形内 packing 26 个圆的结果达到了已知最优的半径之和 2.635983 [62]，并且其阶梯函数改进了 AlphaEvolve 在第二和第三个自相关不等式上的界。 AlphaEvolve 依赖前沿大语言模型，而 SwarmEvolve 则使用小型开源权重的大语言模型组成的群体实现了这些结果。

paragraphs.en: Together, these results show that SwarmEvolve is a faster and more efficient framework for evolutionary search, which finds better programs than text-based frameworks even with a small open-weight LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果共同表明，SwarmEvolve 是一个更快、更高效的进化搜索框架，即使使用小型开源权重 LLM，它也能找到比基于文本的框架更好的程序。

paragraphs.en: SwarmEvolve shows that evolutionary search can be fast, cheap, and strong at the same time. Latent agents skip the slow step of writing text, so one GPU can run hundreds of agents in each round. With the same model and the same time budget, SwarmEvolve evaluates many more programs than text-based frameworks, reaches their final scores early in the run, and ends with higher scores. Even with a small open-weight LLM, it improves on several constructions that AlphaEvolve found with frontier LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: SwarmEvolve 表明，进化搜索可以同时做到快速、低成本且强大。 潜在智能体省去了编写文本这一缓慢步骤，因此一块 GPU 在每一轮中可以运行数百个智能体。 在相同的模型和相同的时间预算下，SwarmEvolve 评估的程序数量远超基于文本的框架，能在运行早期就达到后者的最终分数，并以更高的分数结束。 即使使用小型开放权重 LLM，它也能在多个构造上超越 AlphaEvolve 用前沿 LLM 找到的结果。

sents.en: SwarmEvolve shows that evolutionary search can be fast, cheap, and strong at the same time.
sents.zh: SwarmEvolve 表明，进化搜索可以同时做到快速、低成本且强大。

sents.en: Latent agents skip the slow step of writing text, so one GPU can run hundreds of agents in each round.
sents.zh: 潜在智能体省去了编写文本这一缓慢步骤，因此一块 GPU 在每一轮中可以运行数百个智能体。

sents.en: With the same model and the same time budget, SwarmEvolve evaluates many more programs than text-based frameworks, reaches their final scores early in the run, and ends with higher scores.
sents.zh: 在相同的模型和相同的时间预算下，SwarmEvolve 评估的程序数量远超基于文本的框架，能在运行早期就达到后者的最终分数，并以更高的分数结束。

sents.en: Even with a small open-weight LLM, it improves on several constructions that AlphaEvolve found with frontier LLMs.
sents.zh: 即使使用小型开放权重 LLM，它也能在多个构造上超越 AlphaEvolve 用前沿 LLM 找到的结果。

paragraphs.en: Latent reasoning is a key part of this gain. When we replace the latent reasoning steps with text reasoning, the scores drop (Appendix A.1 ), even when the agents are given a higher text token budget than the latent token budget. Longer text makes each round slower, so the search evaluates fewer programs in the same time and ends with lower scores. Latent reasoning gives each agent enough room to think while keeping each round short.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在推理是这一提升的关键部分。 当我们把潜在推理步骤替换为文本推理时，分数会下降（附录 A.1），即使给智能体的文本 token 预算高于潜在 token 预算也是如此。 更长的文本会使每一轮变慢，因此搜索在同一时间内评估的程序更少，最终得分也更低。 潜在推理既给每个智能体留出了足够的思考空间，又保持了每一轮的简短。

sents.en: Latent reasoning is a key part of this gain.
sents.zh: 潜在推理是这一提升的关键部分。

sents.en: When we replace the latent reasoning steps with text reasoning, the scores drop (Appendix A.1 ), even when the agents are given a higher text token budget than the latent token budget.
sents.zh: 当我们把潜在推理步骤替换为文本推理时，分数会下降（附录 A.1），即使给智能体的文本 token 预算高于潜在 token 预算也是如此。

sents.en: Longer text makes each round slower, so the search evaluates fewer programs in the same time and ends with lower scores.
sents.zh: 更长的文本会使每一轮变慢，因此搜索在同一时间内评估的程序更少，最终得分也更低。

sents.en: Latent reasoning gives each agent enough room to think while keeping each round short.
sents.zh: 潜在推理既给每个智能体留出了足够的思考空间，又保持了每一轮的简短。

paragraphs.en: Scaling the number of agents in a swarm also helps to improve the framework performance early in the search (Appendix A.2 ). Since a larger swarm studies each parent program from more perspectives, each round explores more of the design space initially. This early advantage matters most when each evaluation is expensive, such as a large simulation in science or engineering, where only a few programs can be evaluated. Later in the search, swarms of different sizes reach similar scores, while scaling to larger, more intelligent LLMs still raises the final score consistently.
paragraphs.zh: 扩大群体中智能体的数量也有助于在搜索早期提升框架性能（附录 A.2）。 由于更大的群体能从更多角度研究每个父代程序，每一轮在初始阶段会探索更多的设计空间。 当每次评估成本高昂时（例如科学或工程领域的大型仿真，只能评估少数程序），这种早期优势最为重要。 在搜索后期，不同规模的群体会达到相近的分数，而扩展到更大、更智能的大语言模型仍能持续提高最终分数。

sents.zh: 扩大群体中智能体的数量也有助于在搜索早期提升框架性能（附录 A.2）。

sents.en: Since a larger swarm studies each parent program from more perspectives, each round explores more of the design space initially.

sents.en: This early advantage matters most when each evaluation is expensive, such as a large simulation in science or engineering, where only a few programs can be evaluated.
sents.zh: 当每次评估成本高昂时（例如科学或工程领域的大型仿真，只能评估少数程序），这种早期优势最为重要。

sents.en: Later in the search, swarms of different sizes reach similar scores, while scaling to larger, more intelligent LLMs still raises the final score consistently.
sents.zh: 在搜索后期，不同规模的群体会达到相近的分数，而扩展到更大、更智能的大语言模型仍能持续提高最终分数。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, SwarmEvolve makes large-scale search for new programs affordable on a single GPU. This opens the method to many problems in mathematics and scientific computing. In mathematics, swarms can search for new constructions and proof strategies. In computing, they can improve algorithms for speed and accuracy. In scientific computing, they can write better PDE solvers, discover formulas through symbolic regression, and design more efficient numerical methods. Many of these problems have clear evaluators or desired outcomes, such as a higher accuracy or faster speed, which is what evolutionary search needs.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛地说，SwarmEvolve 使得在单个 GPU 上大规模搜索新程序变得可行。 这为数学和科学计算中的许多问题开启了使用该方法的可能性。 在数学中，群体可以搜索新的构造和证明策略。 在计算中，它们可以改进算法的速度和准确性。 在科学计算中，它们可以编写更好的偏微分方程求解器、通过符号回归发现公式，并设计更高效的数值方法。 其中许多问题都有明确的评估器或期望的结果，例如更高的精度或更快的速度，而这正是进化搜索所需要的。

paragraphs.en: SwarmEvolve has three limitations. First, all latent agents and summarizers share one LLM, because a summarizer can read the KV caches of its agents directly only when they come from the same model. Learned translations between the KV caches of different models [ 23 ] could extend SwarmEvolve to swarms whose agents run different models. Second, our implementation requires LLMs with standard attention. Linear-attention, state-space, and hybrid models compress the past into a fixed-size state [ 36 , 27 , 76 ] , so latent communication between them needs a way to merge the states of several agents. Third, the memory for the KV caches of a round grows linearly with the number of agents, the number of latent reasoning steps, and the number of layers, so the largest LLM we test needs a large GPU. Compressed latent messages [ 11 ] and rounds spread over several GPUs could let SwarmEvolve scale to larger models and longer runs.
paragraphs.zh: SwarmEvolve 存在三个局限性。 首先，所有潜在智能体和摘要器共享同一个 LLM，因为只有当智能体的 KV 缓存来自同一模型时，摘要器才能直接读取它们。 不同模型的 KV 缓存之间的学习式翻译 [23] 可以将 SwarmEvolve 扩展到智能体运行不同模型的群体。 其次，我们的实现要求 LLM 采用标准注意力机制。 线性注意力、状态空间和混合模型将过去压缩为固定大小的状态 [36, 27, 76]，因此它们之间的潜在通信需要一种合并多个智能体状态的方法。 第三，存储一轮 KV 缓存的内存随智能体数量、潜在推理步数和层数线性增长，因此我们测试的最大 LLM 需要一块大型 GPU。 压缩的潜在消息 [11] 以及分布在多块 GPU 上的轮次，可以让 SwarmEvolve 扩展到更大的模型和更长的运行时间。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SwarmEvolve, an evolutionary search framework in which swarms of low-cost agents reason in latent space and communicate by passing KV caches. This design lets one GPU run hundreds of agents in each round, so the search explores much more of the design space in the same time. On problems from mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve finds better programs faster than text-based frameworks, and with a small open-weight LLM it improves on several results that AlphaEvolve found with frontier LLMs. These results show that large-scale search for new mathematical constructions, algorithms, and scientific computing methods does not necessarily need frontier models or large compute budgets. Swarms of small latent agents can make this kind of AI-driven scientific discovery fast, cheap, capable, and widely available.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SwarmEvolve，一个演化搜索框架，其中由低成本智能体组成的群体在潜在空间中进行推理，并通过传递 KV 缓存进行通信。 这一设计让单块 GPU 在每一轮中运行数百个智能体，因此搜索能在相同时间内探索大得多的设计空间。 在来自数学发现和科学计算的问题上，SwarmEvolve 比基于文本的框架更快地找到更好的程序，并且使用一个小型开源权重 LLM，它改进了 AlphaEvolve 借助前沿 LLM 得到的若干结果。 这些结果表明，对新数学构造、算法和科学计算方法的大规模搜索并不一定需要前沿模型或庞大的算力预算。 由小型潜在智能体组成的群体可以让这种 AI 驱动的科学发现变得快速、廉价、强大且广泛可得。

paragraphs.en: Using Qwen3 8B, we replace each agent’s 40 latent reasoning steps with text reasoning of up to 40 tokens, which matches the latent budget, or up to 256 tokens, which is enough for a short paragraph. The summarizer receives this text in its prompt. Latent reasoning gives the highest average score after 60 minutes, 0.804, against 0.796 and 0.767 for 40 and 256 tokens of text reasoning (Supplementary Table 1 ).

The summarizers then encode the text of their agents, which adds 8 seconds per round with 40 tokens and 15 seconds with 256 tokens. In 60 minutes, SwarmEvolve therefore evaluates 734 programs with latent reasoning, more than the 663 and 402 with 40 and 256 tokens of text reasoning.

paragraphs.en: We vary the number of latent agents in each swarm with Qwen3 8B: 0, 15, 45 (the default), and 75. paragraphs.en: Larger latent teams raise the score most early in the search (Supplementary Figures 1 and 2 ). Over the first 150 evaluated programs, the mean best score increases with the swarm size. From the 55th program on, SwarmEvolve with 75 agents has the highest mean best score of all settings and baselines. The three baselines evaluate 80 to 160 programs in 60 minutes, and their final scores lie below the final score of every swarm size. After about 150 programs, the gains fall within the bootstrap intervals. Smaller swarms run faster, so they evaluate more programs in the 60-minute budget and their scores keep rising for longer. All four settings end the hour at similar scores.
paragraphs.zh: 更大的潜在智能体团队在搜索早期最能提高分数（补充图 1 和图 2）。 在前 150 个被评估的程序中，平均最佳分数随蜂群规模增大而上升。 从第 55 个程序开始，拥有 75 个智能体的 SwarmEvolve 在所有设置和基线中具有最高的平均最佳分数。 三个基线在 60 分钟内评估 80 到 160 个程序，它们的最终分数均低于每种蜂群规模的最终分数。 在大约 150 个程序之后，增益落在自助法区间之内。 更小的蜂群运行更快，因此在 60 分钟的预算内能评估更多程序，其分数在更长时间内持续上升。 所有四种设置在一小时结束时得到相近的分数。

paragraphs.en: The early gain suggests that a larger swarm examines each program from more perspectives, so its summarizer draws on more diverse ideas. The later convergence likely reflects the limits of the LLM itself. Since all latent agents share their knowledge, additional agents can’t find the blind spots that earlier agents overlook, and the diversity gain saturates. A larger model does raise the final score as shown in Table 1 .

paragraphs.en: Compared with the three baselines, SwarmEvolve achieves a higher throughput mainly in the following two ways:
paragraphs.zh: 与三个基线相比，SwarmEvolve 主要通过以下两种方式实现了更高的吞吐量：

paragraphs.en: Latent reasoning instead of text reasoning. Text reasoning takes most of the GPU time of all three baselines, 20 to 35 seconds and several thousand tokens per evaluated program. SwarmEvolve replaces it with latent reasoning and latent communication, which together take about a tenth of its GPU time: the latent agents of a round reason for a few seconds in total. SwarmEvolve therefore spends most of its GPU time writing programs, and this shift explains its higher throughput.

paragraphs.en: We implement SwarmEvolve in PyTorch with the Qwen3 models of Hugging Face Transformers [ 72 ] . The latent agents of a round run as one batch, and latent agents that read the same program attend to one shared copy of its KV cache through the paged FlashAttention kernel of vLLM [ 18 , 41 ] . The summarizers of a round decode as one batch with paged KV caches and prompt-lookup speculative sampling, which drafts tokens by copying them from the programs in the context [ 57 ] and verifies them with the acceptance rule of speculative sampling, so the samples follow the distribution of the model exactly [ 44 ] . With Qwen3 14B and 32B-FP8, SwarmEvolve also captures its decoding steps in CUDA graphs and uses the fused kernels of vLLM, including FlashAttention-3 on the H100 GPU [ 58 ] . The three baselines serve the model with vLLM, which batches requests continuously, caches shared prefixes, and runs CUDA graphs, so their decoding runs at the speed of a production serving engine. CodeEvolve runs its configuration for Qwen models with eight islands, one per CPU core. All four frameworks run Qwen3 32B-FP8, which uses the FP8 weights released by Qwen.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于 PyTorch 实现 SwarmEvolve，并使用 Hugging Face Transformers [72] 中的 Qwen3 模型。 每一轮的潜在智能体作为一个批次运行，而读取同一程序的潜在智能体通过 vLLM [18, 41] 的分页 FlashAttention 内核共同关注该程序 KV 缓存的一份共享副本。 每一轮的摘要器作为一个批次进行解码，使用分页 KV 缓存和提示查找投机采样，该方法通过从上下文中的程序复制令牌来起草 [57]，并用投机采样的接受规则进行验证，因此采样结果严格遵循模型的分布 [44]。 在 Qwen3 14B 和 32B-FP8 上，SwarmEvolve 还通过 CUDA 图捕获其解码步骤，并使用 vLLM 的融合内核，包括 H100 GPU 上的 FlashAttention-3 [58]。 三个基线方法均使用 vLLM 来服务模型，vLLM 可连续批处理请求、缓存共享前缀并运行 CUDA 图，因此它们的解码速度达到生产级服务引擎的水平。 CodeEvolve 在其面向 Qwen 模型的配置中使用八个岛，每个 CPU 核心一个。 四个框架均运行 Qwen3 32B-FP8，该模型使用 Qwen 发布的 FP8 权重。

paragraphs.en: Two problems need care in the comparison with AlphaEvolve. On the third autocorrelation inequality, the evaluator of OpenEvolve takes the absolute value of the autoconvolution inside the maximum, while AlphaEvolve’s published bound of 1.4557 takes it outside the maximum. Under the definition of the evaluator, AlphaEvolve’s construction gives 1.4688, the value that we compare against (Appendix D.12 ). On the uncertainty inequality, the evaluator accepts only functions built from Hermite polynomials. Within this family, AlphaEvolve’s first construction gives 0.3521, while its best bound of 0.3216 uses Laguerre polynomials, which lie outside the family. SwarmEvolve reaches 0.3521 with Qwen3 32B-FP8, the value of AlphaEvolve’s construction within the same family.

paragraphs.zh: 我们将每个框架找到的最佳程序与 Qwen3 8B 在一个装箱问题、一个几何问题以及三个 PDE 问题上进行比较。 对于每个框架，选择得分最高的程序。 对于 PDE 问题，我们在相同的对数尺度上绘制逐点绝对误差 |u − u_ref|，其中 u 是每个框架的解，u_ref 是参考解，并适用于所有三个问题。

sents.en: We compare the best program that each framework found with Qwen3 8B for one packing problem, one geometry problem, and the three PDE problems.
sents.zh: 我们将每个框架找到的最佳程序与 Qwen3 8B 在一个装箱问题、一个几何问题以及三个 PDE 问题上进行比较。

sents.en: For each framework, the highest-scoring program is selected.
sents.zh: 对于每个框架，选择得分最高的程序。

sents.en: For the PDE problems, we plot the pointwise absolute error | u − u ref | |u-u_{\mathrm{ref}}| , where u u is each framework’s solution and u ref u_{\mathrm{ref}} is the reference solution, on the same logarithmic scale for all three problems.
sents.zh: 对于 PDE 问题，我们在相同的对数尺度上绘制逐点绝对误差 |u − u_ref|，其中 u 是每个框架的解，u_ref 是参考解，并适用于所有三个问题。

paragraphs.en: Supplementary Figure 16 shows the best packing of each framework.
paragraphs.zh: 补充图 16 展示了每种框架的最佳堆积方式。

paragraphs.en: The program runs ten restarts of one SLSQP optimization over all centers and radii, each from 16 perturbed lattice positions and 10 random positions, and keeps the best valid packing.
paragraphs.zh: 程序对所有圆心和半径运行十次 SLSQP 优化的重启，每次分别从 16 个扰动的格点和 10 个随机位置出发，并保留最佳的可行装填结果。

paragraphs.en: The program places one circle at the center, eight on an inner ring, four in the corners, and thirteen on an outer ring, and optimizes all centers and radii with one SLSQP run.
paragraphs.zh: 程序在中心放置一个圆，在内环放置八个圆，在四角放置四个圆，在外环放置十三个圆，并通过一次 SLSQP 运行优化所有圆心与半径。

paragraphs.en: The program places one circle at the center, eight on an inner ring, thirteen on an outer ring clipped to the square, and four near the corners, and optimizes all centers and radii with one SLSQP run.
paragraphs.zh: 程序在中心放置一个圆，在内环放置八个，在外环放置十三个（裁剪到正方形范围内），在四个角附近放置四个，并通过一次 SQP 运行优化所有圆心和半径。

paragraphs.en: The program places 25 circles on a 5 × 5 5\times 5 lattice and one at the center, and optimizes all centers and radii with one SLSQP run.
paragraphs.zh: 程序在 5 × 5 5\times 5 格点上放置 25 个圆，并在中心放置一个圆，然后通过一次 SLSQP 运行来优化所有圆心和半径。

paragraphs.en: Supplementary Figure 17 shows the best placement of each framework.
paragraphs.zh: 补充图 17 展示了每个框架的最佳部署位置。

paragraphs.en: The program runs ten restarts of simulated annealing from a symmetric lattice of points, moving one point at a time and accepting a worse smallest area with a probability that decreases as the temperature drops.
paragraphs.zh: 程序从对称点阵开始运行十次模拟退火重启，每次移动一个点，并以随温度下降而降低的概率接受较差的最小面积。

paragraphs.en: The program draws 11 random points in the triangle, redrawing a point whenever it is collinear with two earlier points.
paragraphs.zh: 程序在三角形内随机绘制 11 个点，每当某个点与之前两个点共线时，就重新绘制该点。

paragraphs.en: The program draws random configurations from 50 fixed seeds, keeps the best ones, and refines them with SLSQP on the smallest triangle area under the three edge constraints of the triangle.
paragraphs.zh: 该程序从 50 个固定种子中抽取随机构型，保留其中最优者，并在三角形的三个边约束下，以最小三角形面积为目标，用 SLSQP 对其进行优化。

paragraphs.en: The program draws 11 random points in the triangle and runs one simulated annealing of 50,000 steps that moves one point at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 程序在三角形内随机绘制 11 个点，并运行一次 50,000 步的模拟退火，每次移动一个点。

paragraphs.en: Supplementary Figure 18 shows the solution of each framework for the smallest viscosity and its error.
paragraphs.zh: 补充图 18 展示了各智能体框架在最小粘度下的求解结果及其误差。

paragraphs.en: The program uses central finite differences on 8192 grid points for ν < 0.01 \nu<0.01 and 2048 points otherwise, with a two-stage Runge–Kutta method and a time step limited by both the advection and the diffusion stability conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 该程序在 ν < 0.01 \nu<0.01 时使用 8192 个网格点上的中心有限差分，其他情况下使用 2048 个网格点，并采用两阶段 Runge–Kutta 方法，时间步长同时受对流和扩散稳定性条件的限制。

paragraphs.en: The program uses central finite differences of the flux u 2 / 2 u^{2}/2 on 2048 grid points with forward Euler time steps.
paragraphs.zh: 程序在 2048 个网格点上使用通量 u 2 / 2 u^{2}/2 的中心有限差分，并采用前向欧拉时间步进。

paragraphs.en: The program splits each time step into a two-stage Runge–Kutta step for the advection on 1024 grid points and an implicit diffusion step solved exactly in Fourier space.
paragraphs.zh: 程序将每个时间步拆分为两部分：在 1024 个网格点上执行平流的两级 Runge–Kutta 步，以及在傅里叶空间中精确求解的隐式扩散步。

paragraphs.en: The program uses central finite differences of the flux u 2 / 2 u^{2}/2 on 1024 grid points with the explicit midpoint method, a two-stage Runge–Kutta method, and a time step limited by both the advection and the diffusion stability conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 该程序在 1024 个网格点上对通量 u 2 / 2 u^{2}/2 使用中心有限差分，采用显式中点法（一种两阶段 Runge–Kutta 方法），并且时间步长同时受到对流稳定性条件和扩散稳定性条件的限制。

paragraphs.en: Supplementary Figure 19 shows the solution of each framework for ε = 10 − 3 \varepsilon=10^{-3} and its error.
paragraphs.zh: 补充图 19 展示了各智能体框架在 ε = 10 − 3 \varepsilon=10^{-3} 下的解及其误差。

paragraphs.en: The program uses central finite differences on a 768 × 768 768\times 768 grid with a sparse direct solver and bilinear interpolation to the evaluation points.
paragraphs.zh: 该程序在 768 × 768 768\times 768 网格上使用中心有限差分、稀疏直接求解器以及到评估点的双线性插值。

paragraphs.en: The program uses central finite differences on a 512 × 512 512\times 512 grid with a sparse direct solver and bilinear interpolation.
paragraphs.zh: 该程序在 512 × 512 512\times 512 网格上使用中心有限差分，配合稀疏直接求解器和双线性插值。

paragraphs.en: The program uses central finite differences on a 128 × 128 128\times 128 grid with a sparse direct solver and bilinear interpolation.
paragraphs.zh: 该程序在 128 × 128 128\times128 网格上使用中心有限差分、稀疏直接求解器以及双线性插值。

paragraphs.en: Supplementary Figure 20 shows the solution of each framework for k = 40 k=40 and its error.
paragraphs.zh: 补充图 20 展示了各框架在 k = 40 k=40 时的解及其误差。

paragraphs.en: The program uses second-order finite differences with ghost points for the impedance condition on an 818 × 818 818\times 818 grid, a sparse direct solver, and bilinear interpolation.
paragraphs.zh: 该程序在 818 × 818 818\times 818 网格上使用带虚拟点的二阶有限差分来处理阻抗条件，并采用稀疏直接求解器和双线性插值。

paragraphs.en: The program uses the same discretization on a 301 × 301 301\times 301 grid.
paragraphs.zh: 程序在 301 × 301 301\times 301 的网格上使用相同的离散化方法。

paragraphs.en: The program uses the same discretization on a 601 × 601 601\times 601 grid.
paragraphs.zh: 该程序在 601 × 601 601\times 601 网格上使用相同的离散化方法。

paragraphs.en: The program uses the same discretization on a 401 × 401 401\times 401 grid and smooths the real and imaginary parts of the solution with a Gaussian filter.
paragraphs.zh: 该程序在 401 × 401 401\times 401 网格上使用相同的离散化方法，并用高斯滤波器对解的实部和虚部进行平滑处理。

paragraphs.en: Supplementary Figure 21 plots the best score so far against wall-clock minutes for each problem and framework with Qwen3 8B, and Supplementary Figures 22 and 23 show the same with Qwen3 14B and 32B-FP8. Each line averages the three runs of a framework, and each band spans its lowest and highest run. With every model, the curves of SwarmEvolve rise most steeply in the first minutes, when its rounds explore many focuses at once, and end the hour highest on most problems. Its bands often lie entirely above those of the baselines, so its lead holds for every seed.
paragraphs.zh: 补充图 21 绘制了使用 Qwen3 8B 时每个问题和框架迄今为止最佳得分随实际运行分钟数的变化，补充图 22 和 23 展示了使用 Qwen3 14B 和 32B-FP8 时的相同结果。 每条线对一个框架的三次运行取平均值，每条带覆盖其最低与最高的运行。 在所有模型下，SwarmEvolve 的曲线在最初几分钟上升最陡，此时其各轮次同时探索多个焦点，并且在大多数问题上于这一小时结束时得分最高。 它的带常常完全位于基线的带之上，因此其优势在所有种子下都保持不变。
